age_groups.name: Infancy (0 - 1 Year)
age_groups.focus: Neonatal immunity, metabolic stabilization, and digestive protection

diseases.symptoms: Lethargy, hypothermia or fever, poor suckling, respiratory distress, grunting, jaundice, bulging fontanelle
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Complete Blood Count (CBC), C-Reactive Protein (CRP), Random Blood Glucose, Pulse Oximetry
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Blood & CSF Cultures (Lumbar Puncture), Serum Procalcitonin, Arterial Blood Gas (ABG), Cranial Ultrasound
diseases.dosage_form: Sterile-processed pediatric drops, Suvarna enriched rasayana

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Kapha obstruction in Prana vaha srotas
diseases.symptoms: Tachypnea (rapid breathing), nasal flaring, intercostal chest retractions, wheezing, cough, poor feeding
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Nasopharyngeal Viral Antigen Swab, Pulse Oximetry, CBC
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Rapid Multiplex PCR Respiratory Panel, Chest X-ray, Arterial/Capillary Blood Gas Analysis

diseases.symptoms: MUAC < 11.5 cm, visible muscle wasting (marasmus), pitting edema (kwashiorkor), sparse hair
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC), WHO Weight-for-Height Z-score, Hemoglobin
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Serum Electrolytes (Potassium/Magnesium), Serum Albumin & Prealbumin, Zinc & Vitamin A Levels

diseases.symptoms: Cyanosis (bluish skin/lips), feeding fatigue, excessive sweating while nursing, heart murmur, poor weight gain
diseases.basic_diagnostics: 4-Limb Pulse Oximetry Screening, Chest X-ray, 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Transthoracic Echocardiography (Echo), Cardiac MRI, Pediatric Cardiac Catheterization

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Pitta-Kapha dushti in Anna vaha srotas
diseases.symptoms: Explosive watery stools, abdominal distension, severe colic/gas, eczema, flecks of blood or mucus in stool
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Stool pH, Stool Reducing Substances, Stool Routine & Microscopy (occult blood check)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Milk-Specific Serum IgE, Skin Prick Testing, Hydrogen Breath Test, Diagnostic Food Elimination & Challenge
diseases.dosage_form: Deepana-Pachana herbal syrups, Gripe water variants

age_groups.name: Toddlers & Early Childhood (1 - 5 Years)
age_groups.focus: Weaning transition support, parasite control, and infection defense

diseases.symptoms: Height-for-age Z-score < -2 SD, weight-for-height Z-score < -2 SD, delayed motor milestones, chronic infections
diseases.basic_diagnostics: WHO Growth Chart Plotting, CBC, Urine Routine, Stool Routine
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Thyroid Function Tests (TSH, Free T4), Celiac Serology (tTG-IgA), Serum IGF-1, Stool Elastase

diseases.symptoms: Perianal nocturnal itching (pinworms), abdominal pain, bloating, unexplained weight loss, passing worms
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Stool Routine & Microscopy (Ova & Parasite count), Cellophane Tape Test
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Stool Concentration Techniques, Blood Absolute Eosinophil Count, Stool PCR Parasite Panel

diseases.symptoms: Maculopapular rash, high fever, Koplik spots (oral), painful swollen parotid glands, conjunctivitis
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Clinical Physical Evaluation, CBC (leukopenia/lymphocytosis), CRP
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Specific Serum Viral Serology (IgM and IgG), Nasopharyngeal/Oral RT-PCR

diseases.symptoms: Sudden altered mental state, drooling, oral mucosal burns, stridor, unexplained pinpoint or dilated pupils
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG), Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP), Toxicology Screen, ECG
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Upper Endoscopy (EGD for corrosive ingestion), Chest/Abdominal X-rays, Contrast CT Scan

age_groups.name: School-Age Children (5 - 10 Years)
age_groups.focus: Cognitive support, vision health, and respiratory care

diseases.symptoms: Toothache, sensitivity to hot/cold/sweet foods, visible dark pits, bleeding gums, halitosis
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Visual-Tactile Examination with Dental Probe, Gingival Index Scoring
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Intraoral Bitewing & Periapical Radiographs, Panoramic Radiograph (OPG), Quantitative Light Fluorescence

diseases.symptoms: Squinting, sitting close to screens, frequent eye rubbing, headaches, blurred distance vision
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Visual Acuity Test (Snellen Chart), Subjective Refraction, Cover/Uncover Test
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Cycloplegic Refraction, Ocular Axial Length Measurement (Optical Biometry), Corneal Topography
diseases.dosage_form: Triphala Ghrita capsules, specialized eye drops

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Prana vaha srotas obstruction by Kapha
diseases.symptoms: Recurrent wheezing, dry cough at night or during exercise, shortness of breath, chest tightness
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR), Diagnostic Inhaled Bronchodilator Trial
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Pre/Post-Bronchodilator Spirometry, Fractional Exhaled Nitric Oxide (FeNO), Skin Prick Allergy Panel
diseases.dosage_form: Sitopaladi Churna syrup bases, herbal cough drops

diseases.symptoms: Inattention, hyperactivity, impulsivity, failure to follow multi-step instructions, academic lag
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Standardized Questionnaires (Conners 3, Vanderbilt), Hearing & Vision Screening
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Comprehensive Neuropsychological Evaluation, Continuous Performance Test (CPT), WISC-V

diseases.symptoms: BMI >= 95th percentile (obesity), acanthosis nigricans (dark neck folds), exertion dyspnea
diseases.basic_diagnostics: BMI-for-age Percentile Calculation, Office Blood Pressure, Fasting Glucose
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT), Fasting Insulin, Liver Enzymes (ALT/AST), DXA Body Composition
diseases.dosage_form: Functional herbal malt drinks, metabolism gummies

age_groups.name: Adolescents & Teenagers (10 - 20 Years)
age_groups.focus: Pubertal hormone balancing, acne management, and mental stress

diseases.symptoms: Comedones (blackheads/whiteheads), inflammatory papules, painful nodulocystic lesions, scarring
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Clinical Visual Assessment, Global Acne Grading System (GAGS)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Serum Free & Total Testosterone, DHEAS, LH/FSH Ratio, Lesion Bacterial/Fungal Culture
diseases.dosage_form: Herbal face washes, Manjisthadi blood purifiers

diseases.symptoms: Oligomenorrhea (infrequent periods), hirsutism (excess facial/body hair), cystic acne, weight gain
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Serum Free/Total Testosterone, LH & FSH Levels, Fasting Lipid Panel
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Pelvic Ultrasound (Ovarian volume & follicle count), Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH), 17-OHP

diseases.symptoms: Darkening skin folds (acanthosis nigricans), abdominal adiposity, post-meal fatigue, intense sugar cravings
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Fasting Blood Glucose, HbA1c, Fasting Lipid Panel
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Fasting Insulin & HOMA-IR Calculation, 2-Hour Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT)

diseases.symptoms: Panic attacks before exams, persistent low mood, loss of interest, sleep disturbances, tension headaches
diseases.basic_diagnostics: PHQ-9 (Depression) & GAD-7 (Anxiety) Questionnaires, TSH, Vitamin D & B12
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Neuropsychiatric Diagnostic Evaluation, Polysomnography (Sleep Study)

diseases.symptoms: Persistent dry cough, throat irritation, severe nicotine cravings, chest tightness, restlessness
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Pulse Oximetry, Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (Vape-adapted), Lung Auscultation
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Quantitative Urine Cotinine/Nicotine Level, High-Resolution Chest CT (HRCT for EVALI), Spirometry

age_groups.name: Young Adults (20 - 30 Years)
age_groups.focus: Lifestyle metabolic protection, spinal health, and liver detoxification

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Kleda accumulation in Meda and Mutra
diseases.symptoms: Often silent; mild post-meal fatigue, slow healing of minor cuts, increased thirst
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Fasting Plasma Glucose (100–125 mg/dL), HbA1c (5.7–6.4%)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: 75g 2-Hour OGTT (140–199 mg/dL), Fasting Serum Insulin, High-Sensitivity CRP (hs-CRP)

diseases.symptoms: Unexplained fatigue, premature venous thrombosis (DVT), early exertional chest tightness
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Fasting Plasma Homocysteine, Routine Lipid Profile, Complete Blood Count
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: MTHFR Gene Mutation Analysis (C677T/A1298C), Serum Vitamin B12 & Methylmalonic Acid

diseases.symptoms: Neck stiffness, radiating arm pain, numbness/tingling in thumb and index/middle fingers, weak grip
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Physical Provocative Tests (Phalen’s, Tinel’s, Spurling’s), Cervical Spine X-ray
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS) & EMG, Cervical Spine MRI, High-Resolution Median Nerve Ultrasound

diseases.symptoms: Chronic brain fog, exhaustion, peripheral paresthesias (tingling), hair thinning, brittle nails
diseases.basic_diagnostics: CBC, Vitamin D (25-OH), Vitamin B12, Serum Ferritin & Iron Studies
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Methylmalonic Acid (MMA), Red Blood Cell (RBC) Folate, Active B12 (Holotranscobalamin)

diseases.symptoms: Silent; mild discomfort in the upper right abdomen, persistent fatigue
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Liver Function Tests (ALT/AST), Abdominal Ultrasound, Fasting Lipid Panel
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Transient Elastography (FibroScan), FIB-4 Score, Magnetic Resonance Elastography (MRE), Liver Biopsy

age_groups.name: Established Adults (30 - 40 Years)
age_groups.focus: Chronic disease onset prevention (Hypertension, Diabetes, NASH, Thyroid)

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Vyan Vata and Rakta pressure elevation
diseases.symptoms: Silent ('Silent Killer'); morning occipital headaches, lightheadedness, occasional blurred vision
diseases.basic_diagnostics: In-Office Blood Pressure (>=130/80 mmHg), Urinalysis, Serum Creatinine
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: 24-Hour Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring (ABPM), Echocardiogram (LVH assessment), Renal Artery Doppler

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Advanced Meda and Majja dhatu corruption
diseases.symptoms: Polyuria (excessive urination), polydipsia (excessive thirst), polyphagia, sudden weight loss
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Fasting Glucose (>=126 mg/dL), Random Glucose (>=200 mg/dL), HbA1c (>=6.5%)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (uACR), Islet Autoantibodies (Anti-GAD), Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM)

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Yakrit tissue inflammation and fat deposition
diseases.symptoms: Progressive fatigue, persistent right upper quadrant ache, hepatomegaly
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Elevated Transaminases (ALT/AST), Abdominal Ultrasound, Platelet Count
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: FibroScan (CAP & Liver Stiffness E-score), MR Elastography, FibroTest Panel, Liver Biopsy

diseases.symptoms: Unexplained weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation, dry skin, coarse hair, slurred thought processes
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Serum TSH (Elevated in primary), Free T4
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Anti-Thyroid Peroxidase (Anti-TPO) Antibodies, Anti-Thyroglobulin (Anti-Tg), Thyroid Ultrasound

diseases.symptoms: Progressive restriction in opening the mouth (trismus), severe burning sensation with spicy food
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Clinical Exam with Calipers (Inter-incisal distance measurement), Mucosal Palpation
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Incisional Tissue Biopsy, Toluidine Blue Vital Staining, Tissue Autofluorescence (VELscope)

age_groups.name: Middle Age & Transition (40 - 50 Years)
age_groups.focus: Cardiovascular protection, menopausal management, and joint degeneration

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Avarodha in Dhamani via Meda plaque
diseases.symptoms: Exertional chest pressure (angina), shortness of breath, pain radiating to jaw/left arm
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Resting 12-Lead ECG, Lipid Panel (ApoB, LDL-C), Exercise Treadmill Test (TMT)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Coronary Calcium Scoring (CAC), Coronary CT Angiography (CCTA), Invasive Coronary Angiography

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Vata aggravation due to Dhatu depletion
diseases.symptoms: Hot flashes, night sweats, menstrual irregularity, vaginal dryness, mood swings, sleep loss
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Clinical Symptom Questionnaire, Serum FSH, Serum Estradiol
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Bone Mineral Density DXA Scan, Transvaginal Ultrasound (Endometrial thickness evaluation)

diseases.symptoms: Deep knee pain during activity, morning stiffness lasting <30 mins, joint grinding (crepitus)
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Physical Exam (Joint line tenderness & effusion), Weight-Bearing Knee Radiographs
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Knee Joint MRI, Synovial Fluid Analysis (Rule out gout/infection), Diagnostic Arthroscopy
diseases.dosage_form: Shallaki and Guggulu joint support tablets

diseases.symptoms: Low back pain, sciatica (pain shooting down leg), leg numbness, pain worse when sitting
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Neurological Exam (Straight Leg Raise test), Lumbar Spine Radiographs (X-rays)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Lumbar Spine MRI, Electromyography (EMG) & Nerve Conduction Velocity (NCV), CT Myelogram
diseases.dosage_form: Specialized warm liniments and muscle relaxants

age_groups.name: Pre-Senior & Senior (50 - 60+ Years)
age_groups.focus: Multi-morbidity management, neuropathy, bone health, stroke & oncology care

diseases.symptoms: Silent; mild peripheral edema (swollen ankles), frothy/foamy urine, nocturia, elevated BP
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Serum Creatinine with eGFR calculation, Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), Urine Dipstick
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (uACR), Renal Ultrasound, Renal Biopsy

diseases.symptoms: 'Stocking-glove' numbness, burning pain in feet, blurred vision, gastroparesis
diseases.basic_diagnostics: 10g Semmes-Weinstein Monofilament Test, Dilated Fundoscopy, Urine Protein
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS), Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT Retina), Autonomic Function Tests

diseases.dosha_pathogenesis: Severe Vata dominance in Shiras / brain
diseases.symptoms: FAST signs: Facial drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, sudden imbalance/loss of vision
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Emergency Non-Contrast Brain CT, Blood Glucose, Coagulation Profile (PT/INR, aPTT), ECG
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Diffusion-Weighted Brain MRI (DWI), Carotid Doppler Ultrasound, CT/MR Angiography, Holter Monitor

diseases.symptoms: Silent until fracture; height loss >1.5 inches, stooped posture (kyphosis), low-impact fractures
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Bone Density DXA Scan (T-Score <= -2.5), Serum Calcium, 25-OH Vitamin D
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Bone Turnover Markers (Serum CTx & P1NP), Vertebral Fracture Assessment (VFA)

diseases.symptoms: Chronic cough with sputum production, progressive exertional shortness of breath, wheezing
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Post-Bronchodilator Spirometry (FEV1/FVC < 0.70), Pulse Oximetry, Chest Radiograph
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: High-Resolution CT (HRCT) Chest, Arterial Blood Gas (ABG), DLCO Plethysmography, Alpha-1 Antitrypsin
diseases.dosage_form: Vasa and Kantakari pulmonary extract syrups

diseases.symptoms: Lumps (breast), altered bowel habits or rectal bleeding (colon), urinary hesitancy (prostate)
diseases.basic_diagnostics: Mammography (Breast), FIT / Occult Blood Stool Test (Colon), PSA + Digital Rectal Exam (Prostate)
diseases.advanced_diagnostics: Tissue Biopsy & Histopathology, Multiparametric MRI, PET-CT Scan, Specific Tumor Markers (CEA, CA 15-3)
